summary: 25 new tests in 5 new classes plus a test properties file; no existing test modified; suite 120/120

files.content:
# Tests start real servers (restart, upgrade and listener tests): an ephemeral management port
# avoids clashing with anything on the fixed production port 8081. Applies to every test.
management.server.port=0

decisions.choice: Instead of editing IntegrationTest, RateLimitTest, PersistenceRestartTest and ClickPersistenceAndUpgradeTest to set an ephemeral management port, one new src/test/resources/application.properties sets management.server.port=0 for every test
decisions.rationale: Same effect with zero edits to protected existing tests; verified: all 95 existing tests pass unchanged against the new code

decisions.choice: Unit test of the rolling window on a controlled clock (10 admitted, 11th is 429 with exact Retry-After, window rolls, peers isolated) plus integration across stats and delete, missing tokens never counted, valid token works while limited, X-Forwarded-For ignored
decisions.rationale: Each test uses its own peer IP because the limiter is shared across the test context; verified by mutation: disabling the throttle fails 3 tests

decisions.choice: A RANDOM_PORT test starts both real listeners: management only on 127.0.0.1, only health and metrics exposed (env, beans, configprops, heapdump 404), unreachable from this machine's non-loopback IPv4, security headers on management responses too
decisions.rationale: Real sockets are the only honest proof of a network binding; verified by mutation: dropping a header fails 3 tests

decisions.choice: Controller-level test for each store failure type, plus HTTP through a mocked LinkService: 503 service_unavailable, Retry-After: 5, no Location, no internals, counted as outcome 5xx
decisions.rationale: A real H2 outage cannot be produced reliably in-process

decisions.choice: Exact 16,384 accepted and 16,385 rejected via MockMvc, plus a filter-level test with an undeclared length (as with chunked encoding) proving bytes received are counted and a within-limit body is forwarded unchanged
decisions.rationale: MockMvc always declares a length, so the bypass case needs the filter directly

decisions.choice: Output capture while sending requests carrying user agent, forwarded IP, token, cookie and code probes; none appears in logs
decisions.rationale: Executable form of the no-visitor-logging requirement

decisions.choice: TC-FR1/FR2/FR3/FR5/FR9/FR16/FR18/NFR1/NFR2 by LinkLifecycleTest, PersistenceRestartTest, LinkCreationTest, RateLimitTest, NoOutboundFetchTest and RedirectLatencyTest (p99 2.5 ms); TC-FR19 is a review property of the change set (git diff), not a test
decisions.rationale: The existing suite is the contract for unchanged behaviour
Recorded so the absence of defects is an explicit finding
